title: Introduction to Space
description: Start at home and work outward, from the ground under your feet to the strangest objects in the universe.

title: The Age of Dinosaurs
description: Meet the animals of the Late Cretaceous, the world they lived in, and how we know any of it.

title: The Story of Life
description: How life changes over time, how the instructions are stored, and where humans fit into it.

title: How We Know Things
description: A path about evidence itself: what counts as proof, how confident we should be, and how scientists have changed their minds.

title: Planet Earth
description: The planet as a working system: its interior, its volcanoes, and the life that changed its air.
